verdict.rationale: Glama is a SaaS platform (chat, MCP hosting, gateway, directory), so a data-export-and-leave story applies to it. The evidence pack documents no export feature for chats, documents, hosted-server configuration or gateway logs. The OpenAPI directory API, the 'keep your own directory synchronized' claim and the pasteable config blocks are developer building blocks or adjacent features, not a documented full-data export in open formats.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
